title: Agreement Delivery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and the industry's transformation toward a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance our customers' business. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are driving a new era of shipping.

We are now looking for a Agreement Delivery Coordinator to join our Agreement Management team in Amer South .

Responsibilities

  • Spare Parts Procurement & Delivery Management: Place and track spare parts orders to meet client requirements and contractual deadlines.
  • End-to-end delivery: Manage the end-to-end delivery process, ensuring timely shipment and compliance with quality standards.
  • Logistics problem solving: Resolve logistics challenges (e.g., customs, shipping delays) to minimize downtime for clients.
  • Swing Set and parts Procurement: Raise purchase orders (POs) for critical parts, including main components and swing sets in alignment with project schedules.
  • Coordination with project teams: Coordinate with project and internal teams to ensure manufacturing timelines support vessel docking schedules.
  • Classification coordination: Coordinate classification certification of the unit with local classification office.
  • Project Coordination & Workshop Oversight: Lead the review and overhaul main components in workshops, ensuring adherence to technical specifications and safety protocols.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with engineering and workshop teams to troubleshoot issues and validate component readiness.
  • Unit handover and preservation: Coordinate the logics of the units from Wärtsilä workshop to customer, and coordinate preservation and storage activities and share SWR with customer monthly if applicable.
  • Technical Improvements & Upgrades: Propose technical upgrades and modifications to Wärtsilä systems as per technical recommendations; support the implementation of approved upgrades, including cost-benefit analysis and timeline planning.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary interface between clients, internal teams (engineering, procurement, workshops), and external suppliers if needed; provide regular updates to clients on delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans; manage on-the-job change orders.
  • Contract Support: Assist the Contract Manager in updating delivery schedules for spare parts, ensuring alignment with docking plans; monitor and report on budget utilisation for spare parts and upgrades, identifying cost-saving opportunities.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyse root causes of delays or quality issues and recommend corrective actions for Spare Parts, Workshop work, FS work and project work.

Qualifications

  • Experience in 4 stroke Sector: Proven track record in engine systems, including design, development, and implementation.
  • Technical Education: Preferably a degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Process and Logistics Management: Knowledge in process management and logistics.
  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead and manage teams effectively.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of 4 stroke systems and their applications.
  • Project Management: Experience in managing projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to budget.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to adapt to changing project requirements and environments.

Last application date: 08/09/2025

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

This is Wärtsilä. Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Estamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em embarcar em uma jornada com propósito na EP. Antes de tudo, queremos que você conheça um pouco mais sobre quem somos e o impacto que geramos.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
Overview

A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Desenvolvemos líderes de excelência, pautados pela ética e pelo compromisso com a qualidade, contribuindo para gerar confiança no mercado de capitais e em economias em todo o mundo. Dessa forma, exercemos um papel crítico na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor para nossos profissionais, nossos clientes e nossas comunidades.

Quase 35.000 profissionais especializados em atender à indústria financeira em todo o mundo prestam serviços de auditoria, impostos, transações e assessoria empresarial para bancos, seguradoras e gestoras de patrimônio. Nas Américas, é a única organização de contabilidade pública com uma unidade de negócios dedicada a este mercado. A EY é líder em servir o mercado global de serviços financeiros.

O Financial Services Office hoje inclui mais de 4.000 profissionais em 50 localidades por todo EUA, Caribe e América Latina, com especializações que nos permitem obter uma compreensão ampla das questões de negócios e dos desafios do setor financeiro, bem como oferecer serviços integrados para nossos clientes. No Brasil atuam junto aos principais centros mundiais para compartilhar conhecimento relacionado às tendências e regulamentações atuais e emergentes, a fim de ajudar nossos clientes a resolver questões fundamentais em gestão de riscos, controles internos, estratégia, operações e tecnologia da informação.

Este grupo de profissionais, dinâmico e talentoso, busca neste momento o candidato certo para integrar o time e desenvolver uma carreira sólida e ascendente.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). Entregamos soluções sob medida com base nas necessidades específicas de cada negócio, a partir de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas com diferentes perfis, como especialistas em Dados, UX, até analistas de negócios e scrum masters.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como Cientista de Dados Pleno você atuará em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidades de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

Poderá atuar diretamente com as tecnologias mais avançadas de IA Generativa e LLMs (como GPT, LLaMA e Mistral). Ambiente inovador, com forte incentivo à pesquisa aplicada e experimentação em IA. Terá oportunidade de participar do desenvolvimento de soluções reais e escaláveis. Cultura colaborativa e times multidisciplinares. Possibilidade de crescimento acelerado e envolvimento em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e/ou correlatas;
  • Ampla experiência em Python, especialmente para aplicações de IA. Domínio de frameworks de LLMs (ex: Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain, OpenAI API);
  • Proficiência com pipelines de dados, ETL, Apache NiFi, Apache Kafka. Prática com versionamento de código (ex: Git), testes automatizados e programação orientada a objetos;
  • Vivência com integração entre sistemas via APIs ou mensagens. Prompt engineering e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura técnica e ferramentas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA ou Data Science, preferencialmente em empresas do setor financeiro, como bancos e seguradoras, tecnologia, consultorias ou startups;
  • Atuação em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e participação em comunidades ou projetos open source de IA;
  • Familiaridade com publicações, artigos, ou apresentações em eventos de tecnologia;
  • Experiência prévia com validação humana de modelos (human-in-the-loop).
  • Certificações em Data Science (ex: IBM Data Science, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer), ou cursos reconhecidos em Machine Learning, IA ou Big Data.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Como Cientista de Dados você atuará na evolução de modelos baseados em LLMs, desde o prompt engineering até a implantação em produção;
  • Será responsável por criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando ferramentas de mercado (NiFi, Kafka);
  • Irá automatizar processos de ETL e integração entre sistemas;
  • Irá garantir a qualidade, versionamento e testabilidade das soluções desenvolvidase atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY Brasil.

O que oferecemos

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, oferecemos experiências excepcionais com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

AEY acredita na força da diversidade: segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Participe de nossos programas e grupos que apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado(a), motivado(a) e valorizado(a) todos os dias? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados em nossos processos.

  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision, multitask and possess strong initiative, exercise independent judgment within established systems and procedures.

title: Banco de Talentos [A-LAB] - FREELA
description:
Overview

Somos diversos, somos sonhadores e temos o propósito de inspirar nossa comunidade a contar histórias reais com impacto positivo. É por isso que misturamos nossas paixões com trabalho. Dessa forma, queremos conhecer novos talentos que estejam dispostos a trabalhar conosco em formato de freelas. Queremos, cada vez mais, deixar nossas equipes plurais e diversas.

Então, se você quer participar e co-criar histórias e projetos temporários conosco, queremos te conhecer! Se você é freelancer, cadastre-se no banco de talentos e analisaremos seu perfil de acordo com cada uma das oportunidades.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Áreas de atuação

  • Direção de arte

É necessário criar conceitos inovadores alinhados aos objetivos de cada marca, além de traduzir ideias criativas em narrativas visuais claras e objetivas. O diretor de arte precisa enxergar estrategicamente além do briefing, contribuindo na confecção das entregas.

Os motions precisam ter conhecimentos em After Effects e Adobe Premier, além de contribuir com referências visuais de animação e criar novas propostas, para animar as artes criadas por diretores de arte.

  • Redação

Os redatores devem ter pensamentos inovadores e uma curiosidade especial para novos formatos e plataformas. É preciso criar conceitos, roteirizar e escrever copies para peças em formatos objetivos e diferentes formatos, otimizando a comunicação de cada rede.

  • Analista de Conteúdo

Os analistas de conteúdo devem transformar estratégias em ações, ajudando a equipe de social nos briefings e ideias para redes sociais. São responsáveis por definir a volumetria ideal de cada rede, montar a grade de conteúdo de forma estratégica e buscar insights.

O estrategista é responsável por definir toda a estratégia de conteúdo de uma marca, além de desenvolver projetos criativos para as redes sociais, cuidar da qualidade do trabalho e definir o tom de voz da marca.

O time de B.I. é responsável por mapear oportunidades para as marcas na redes sociais, sejam elas tendências, comportamentos ou perfis do consumidor. É necessário ter um olhar criativo para poder transformá-lo em insights, estudos e insumos pra criação.

O produtor acompanha e gerencia todas as etapas da produção: desde a definição do cronograma até a entrega final. Ajuda a controlar a pauta dos motions e editores, faz orçamentos e contrato de terceiros.

O gerente de projetos é responsável pela liderança interna do time, organizando a pauta, fazendo o cronograma dos projetos e tendo a visão macro de quais demandas precisam ser priorizadas.

Gerir, cuidar, liderar e desenvolver pessoas do time são algumas das competências de quem realiza atendimento ao cliente. Além disso, é responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente e cuidado com o escopo de cada projeto.

Contratação PJ.

Oi, somos o A-Lab!

Um laboratório de conteúdo criativo que acredita que, nesse mundo de transformações constantes, algoritmos e inteligência artificial, existe uma coisa que não muda: a importância das boas relações.

Tudo que criamos reflete o cuidado e o interesse real que temos pelas pessoas. São essas conexões verdadeiras que impulsionam nossa habilidade de contar histórias mais autênticas, relevantes e integradas às necessidades das marcas e do público.

Exploramos linguagens, narrativas e formatos para ajudar nossos clientes a construírem comunidades engajadas. Já realizamos projetos em parceria com grandes marcas como Burger King, Uber, Faber Castell, Sorvetes Nestlé, Porto e Itaú .

Sabemos que o bem-estar no trabalho é determinante para gerar motivação diante de um mercado tão acelerado e competitivo. Por isso, temos uma cultura organizacional forte, que estimula as relações saudáveis e oferece condições para que nosso time se sinta confiante inspirado para criar.

Cultivamos um ambiente leve e prezamos por uma troca mútua de respeito e transparência. Incentivamos a colaboração e buscamos conectar as paixões individuais dos a-labers com o que fazemos no dia a dia. É isso que nos faz crescer juntos e ser um lugar de potência para quem está se desenvolvendo com a gente.

NOSSO propósito é provar para o mundo que entregas incríveis nascem de relações saudáveis. Bora colocá-las em prática juntos?

title: Product Owner Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A pessoa Product Owner será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantir alinhamento com a visão estratégica da empresa e mapear a jornada do cliente. Atuará como ponte entre stakeholders e o time de desenvolvimento, acompanhando sprints, validando entregas e tomando decisões ágeis para maximizar o valor entregue ao usuário.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, criando e mantendo uma lista clara e priorizada de funcionalidades, melhorias e correções que precisam ser desenvolvidas. A priorização deverá ser feita com base em critérios como valor de negócio, impacto no cliente, urgência e complexidade técnica.
  • Detalhar requisitos e funcionalidades sob a forma de histórias de usuário (user stories), fornecendo critérios de aceitação claros e compreensíveis para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir que o backlog esteja sempre refinado, constantemente atualizado com feedbacks do cliente e equipe, removendo itens obsoletos ou não mais relevantes.
  • Definir a visão do produto, articulada com as metas estratégicas da empresa e as necessidades do mercado.
  • Mapear a jornada do cliente, entendendo profundamente quem são os usuários, seus problemas e como o produto pode atender a essas necessidades ao longo da sua jornada.
  • Definir as entregas e marcos (milestones) ao longo do tempo, garantindo que haja uma estratégia clara de desenvolvimento e evolução do produto.
  • Negociar e alinhar as expectativas dos stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes: agir como o ponto central de comunicação entre os times técnicos, stakeholders e usuários, evitando mal-entendidos e desentendimentos.
  • Garantir que os objetivos das sprints sejam cumpridos, fornecendo feedback constante e eliminando possíveis impedimentos.
  • Avaliar cada incremento do produto desenvolvido pelo time, verificando se os critérios de aceitação foram cumpridos e se a entrega atende às expectativas do cliente e do mercado.
  • Ser ágil ao tomar decisões, tanto no que diz respeito a novas funcionalidades quanto à manutenção do escopo e à priorização de correções.
  • Balancear o que é tecnicamente possível com o que é economicamente viável, sempre levando em consideração o valor que será entregue ao usuário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com gestão de backlog, priorização de funcionalidades e ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ágeis: Scrum, Kanban e outras metodologias ágeis.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Experiência em criação de histórias de usuário bem definidas, com critérios de aceitação claros e objetivos.
  • Experiência com negociação de prazos, funcionalidades e recursos, equilibrando as demandas do negócio com as limitações técnicas.

title: Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The Canonical Kernel Team is seeking exceptionally talented technology experts and industry veterans with a proven track record in operating systems kernel development or low level system engineering to take the lead in the architecture, implementation, and ongoing delivery of the following (but not limited to) aspects of the Ubuntu Linux kernel:

Responsibilities

  • Driving engagements for key Silicon and Cloud partners to provide optimal solutions for their platforms
  • Leading the mitigation of common vulnerabilities and exposures for Ubuntu Linux as well as driving active hardening in the kernel
  • Architecting enhancements to performance and correctness to make Ubuntu Linux the most reliable and highest performing Linux kernel available today
  • Streamlining the packaging and distribution of particularly troublesome third-party components for optimal experience by end users
  • Developing new means to deliver Ubuntu Linux at scale to the strict quality standards and delivery schedules expected by end users

While not a formal managerial role, the successful candidate will possess strong people skills and natural ability to lead engineers within the team, as well as working with other external teams to coordinate adoption and delivery.

We are looking for individuals with not only an incredibly deep technical background in operating system kernels and distributions, but also a strong flair for leadership and taking initiative to drive ideas and the associated delivery teams to completion.

While we hesitate to put a specific number of years of experience as a requirement for an applicant as that does not take into account relative ability or circumstances, for a comparative guideline we would be seeking candidates with the demonstrated technical equivalent of 15+ years of industry experience.

Location: We have home-based lead kernel engineer roles in every timezone, although the individual aspects as listed above may be linked to a specific geographic region.

What the role entails

  • Set the technical direction and lead the delivery of a team of junior and mid-career engineers for a key aspect of Ubuntu Linux
  • Work closely with management within and outside the team to track and coordinate initiatives to delivery
  • Collaborate daily with other senior technical leadership on the Kernel Team on how best to ensure Ubuntu stays at the pinnacle of Linux distributions

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organised and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Expert understanding of the C programming language
  • Demonstrated expertise working in a *nix-based operating system kernel and distribution. While direct Linux experience would be ideal, it is not required.
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Powerful grasp of the capabilities and nuances of the git version control system
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Ability to travel internationally at least twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong background in RTOS and real-time performance analysis
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience with Rust, ideally as it pertains to the Linux kernel

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre a Odontoclinic

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

Você será responsável pelo time de agentes digitais que tem como missão atuar de forma estratégica para construção do relacionamento com o cliente, a fim de reter, rentabilizar e impulsionar o empreendimento da sua carteira. Além disso, entre as suas atribuições estão:

  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano de experiência em cargo de liderança/supervisão;

  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo;
  • Comunicação clara e efetiva;
  • Foco em resultados, priorizando o alcance das metas.
  • Capacidade analítica, interpretação de dados, transformando insights em ações.
  • Identificar oportunidades e problemas antes de eles se manifestarem, busca soluções inovadoras para superar desafios e gerar valor.

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Join to apply for the Analista de Conteúdo Sênior I Produtos Digitais role at Globo .

Descrição da vaga: A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como Globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo. Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Somos uma área apaixonada por conteúdo com uma visão estratégica de negócios. Somos antenados, pesquisamos novos nichos e estamos sempre atentos à concorrência e tendências de mercado. Nosso principal objetivo é trazer boas histórias que se conectem com o negócio e principalmente com nossos assinantes. Esperamos alguém com repertório amplo, antenado com as transformações do mercado de conteúdo e capaz de propor inovações relevantes para o futuro da nossa curadoria.

  • Experiência em análise e gestão de dados no segmento de TV, streaming e/ou mídias digitais;

  • Habilidade analítica aguçada para tomar decisões estratégicas com base em dados;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades de relacionamento interpessoal para interface com diversas equipes e parceiros;
  • Proatividade, organização e capacidade de gestão em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Visão estratégica e foco em resultados;
  • Pensamento crítico, escuta ativa, comunicação eficaz, proatividade, resiliência, trabalho em equipe;

title: Brazil RINA Consulting HSE Senior Advisor
description:
Overview

Brazil RINA Consulting HSE Senior Advisor role at RINA in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Senior Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role ensures the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures and protocols, for the security of Company assets, projects and business travels.

Key Accountabilities

  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay updated on local, state, and federal health, safety, and environmental regulations. Ensure that the organization complies with all relevant laws and standards.
  • Risk Assessment and Management: Conduct risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate risks and prevent accidents or incidents.
  • HSE Policies and Procedures: Develop, implement, and enforce HSE policies and procedures. Communicate these policies to employees and ensure understanding and adherence.
  • Training and Education: Develop and deliver HSE training programs for employees at all levels. Create educational materials and promote awareness of health and safety issues.
  • Incident Investigation: Lead investigations into accidents, incidents, or near-misses to determine root causes. Implement corrective actions to prevent similar occurrences in the future.
  • Emergency Response Planning: Develop and maintain emergency response plans. Organize and conduct drills and training exercises to prepare employees for emergencies.
  • Inspections and Audits: Conduct regular inspections and audits to identify potential hazards and areas of non-compliance. Work with other departments to address and rectify identified issues.
  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement. Prepare reports on HSE performance for management and regulatory authorities.
  • Collaboration with Other Departments: Collaborate with departments such as operations, engineering, and human resources to integrate HSE considerations into daily activities. Participate in project planning to ensure HSE requirements are met.
  • Environmental Management: Manage environmental programs, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. Implement strategies to reduce the organization's environmental impact.
  • Communication: Communicate regularly with employees, management, and external stakeholders about HSE issues. Foster a culture of safety and environmental responsibility within the organization.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures. Stay informed about industry best practices and technological advancements.
  • Documentation and Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities. Ensure documentation is available for regulatory inspections and audits.
  • Training and Development: Stay current with advancements in HSE practices through professional development. Pursue relevant certifications and attend training programs as needed.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare or Environmental Science

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in health, safety, and environmental roles, especially in oil and gas industry, infrastructure construction. This may include experience in conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing HSE programs in compliance with all applicable Brasilian laws.
  • It is required the qualification of Occupational Safety Technician in accordance with Brazilian legislation Regulatory Standard NR4 of the Ministry of Labour and Employement. Are also required the Lead Auditor ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certificates.
  • Relevant certifications can enhance a candidate's profile. Common certifications include:
  • Lead Auditor ISO 9001
  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
  • Occupational Health and Safety Technician (OHST)
  • Associate Safety Professional (ASP)
  • NEBOSH (National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health) certificate
  • OSHA 30-Hour or 40-Hour General Industry Certification
  • Strong understanding of Brasilian local, state, and federal health, safety, and environmental regulations applicable to engineering consulting companies working in oil and gas industry onshore and offshore, construction of infrastructures, marine consultancy.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for effectively conveying HSE policies, procedures, and issues to employees, management, and regulatory bodies, in brasilian and in english languages.
  • Collaboration skills to work effectively with other departments and teams in integrating HSE considerations into daily operations.
  • Expertise in leading risk assessments, audits, and incident investigations, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement HSE strategies, programs, and policies to ensure a proactive safety culture.

Competencies

  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS - Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources and constraint
  • ADDRESS THE WAY - Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret it in a perspective way
  • MANAGE EMOTIONS - Recognise one's and other's emotions and express and regulate one's reactions
  • CLIENT INTIMACY - Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations, and requirements to ensure maximum satisfaction
  • EARN TRUST - Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity
  • PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT - Promote commitment by keeping promises as a Role Model
  • THINK FORWARD - Capitalise on experiences and translate them into action plans for the future
  • PIONEER CHANGE - Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances
  • BUILD NETWORK - Forge trust relationships, across departments, and outside the organization

RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure & mobility, industry, research & development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion.

At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. Resumo

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

Serviços oferecidos

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.
  • Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica, Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia, Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE);
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;
  • Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estágio (Fellowship) em Catarata.

Condições de Trabalho

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Observação: Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.
  • Avaliação por competências

Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde PAIS

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Missão

Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Overview


Desculpe, a oferta não está disponível, mas você pode realizar uma nova pesquisa ou explorar ofertas semelhantes:



Requisitos


Escolaridade: Curso Superior - Graduação - Completo
PCD: Não

Descrição da vaga


Descrição: Vaga de Analista de Marketing. A vaga envolve o apoio na tomada de decisão e execução da estratégia de conteúdo da empresa.



Atribuições



  • Ajudar na criação de campanhas publicitárias ou promocionais

  • Promover ações de lançamentos de produtos ou serviços

  • Providenciar pesquisas



Sobre a empresa e benefícios


A NOVA nasceu para ser DISRUPTIVA: mostrar que uma agência 100 % Remote-First pode entregar resultados melhores que qualquer operação presencial.



Por que essa vaga é diferente?



  • Impacto imediato: você tocará a estratégia 360° de contas nacionais e internacionais, sendo o \"mini-CMO\" do time.

  • Salário competitivo + bônus por resultado (faixa discutida na 1ª etapa).

  • Trilha rápida para Gerente de Marketing (12-24 meses, de acordo com a performance).

  • Agência enxuta e em escala — suas ideias saem do papel em dias, não em meses.



O que você vai fazer (mãos na massa + liderança)



  1. Planejar campanhas (conteúdo, mídia paga, automação) com OKRs claros.

  2. Desenhar e otimizar funis completos (atração, nutrição, conversão), integrando social, anúncios, e-mail e outros.

  3. Garantir performance: ROAS, CAC, crescimento orgânico e NPS do cliente.

  4. Exigir padrão estético impecável (design, copy, vídeo).

  5. Ser ponte sênior com o cliente: monthly review, relatórios insights-driven.

  6. Liderar o squad: distribuir tarefas, remover impedimentos, acompanhar de perto a produção.

  7. Hands-on sempre que preciso (copy, segmentação de Ads, ajustes em LP).



Para brilhar aqui, você precisa



  • 6+ anos em marketing digital com cases comprovados (ex.: ROAS = 3, CAC reduzido, growth orgânico expressivo).

  • Domínio real de mídia orgânica e paga (Meta / Google) e funis/automações (HubSpot, ActiveCampaign etc.).

  • Copywriting persuasivo + leitura ninja de dados (GA4, UTMs, dashboards).

  • Visão T-shaped: entende de social, design, funil, analytics e quer aprender sempre.

  • Energia de dono(a): resolve, prioriza, decide.

  • Inglês fluente.



Diferenciais



  • SEO on-page, Webflow/WordPress básico.

  • Gestão de orçamentos > R$ 100 k/mês.

  • Certificações Meta/Google/HubSpot.



Cultura NOVA


Alta exigência + aprendizado constante + crescimento rápido. Zero espaço para mediocridade. Excelência radical e atenção obsessiva aos detalhes – qualidade acima de tudo. Prazos são lei – planejamento firme, entrega no horário, zero desculpas. Feedback direto e objetivo – problemas são resolvidos sem rodeios. Compromisso com resultados.



Processo de seleção


Processo relâmpago / Início Imediato



Como se candidatar


Envie CV + deck de case/portfolio (antes & depois, números) por email até 30/05. Em um documento à parte, no mesmo email, responda às perguntas:



  • Quando você cria a copy de uma página de vendas ou landing page, quais elementos considera essenciais para gerar conversão?

  • Ao criar conteúdos para redes sociais, como você decide o formato ideal (post, reels, carrossel), frequência e copy?

  • Quando um conteúdo não performa como esperado, quais dados você analisa primeiro e como decide se ajusta ou mantém a estratégia?



Etapas subsequentes



  1. Triagem (24 h)

  2. Entrevista com recrutador

  3. Entrevista com founders

  4. Desafio prático

  5. Oferta



Encerramento


Pronto para crescer com a gente?


Envie seu material com o assunto \"Coordenador(a) de Marketing — NOME E SOBRENOME\".



NOVA Agência de Marketing

title: Post Doctoral Research Associate
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The purpose of this position is to perform highly skilled research or analyses involving complex scientific methods or a complex series of steps. Responsible for overseeing or conducting critical parts of research projects. May also perform the day-to-day coordination of a research group, taking charge of the execution of parts of a research project. This position typically reports to a Principal Investigator (PI).

Supervisory Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training others and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a lead or senior capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature And Scope

To establish internal and external contact with institute’s staff, researchers and junior researchers, and outside vendors for the purpose of gathering and exchanging information.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in conducting literature reviews needed to successfully complete a major project.
  • Assist in formulating and developing guidelines for applying to educational practice the finding form the literature reviews.
  • Under the direction of the PI, serve as an advisor and work closely with the staff of the project in the conduct of classroom field research.
  • Conduct workshops that will benefit staff working with certain targeted populations and make public presentations regarding the research projects.
  • Perform administrative work in support of research objectives, develop and monitors project budget and authorize expenditures of project funds.
  • Design, fabricate, repair and/or operate research equipment for the development of research data as required.
  • Plan and coordinate computerized statistical analyses for advanced and comprehensive research projects, which include consulting with other researchers to derive an understanding of the hypothesis and experimental approach and deciding upon appropriate statistical analyses for various designs.

Core Competencies

  • Ability to develop and write manuscripts and make presentations.
  • Advanced knowledge of the principles and techniques of the subject discipline.
  • Knowledge of modern research methods, data collection and analysis and skill in their application.
  • Skill in leading, or coordinating the work of others.
  • Competence in both oral and written English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, university officials and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

Ph.D. economics or research discipline related to the economics.

Salary Range

$70,000-79,000

Seniority level

  • Entry level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Research, Analyst, and Information Technology

Industries

  • Online Audio and Video Media

Overview


Locations : São Paulo | Rio de Janeiro


Software Engineer, QA, Brazil - X Delivery at BCG X


Note: This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, within a 150km radius of the capitals.


What You'll Do


As a Software Developer in Test at BCG X, you will play a pivotal role in improving our software development lifecycle, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, robust software solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of Concepts/Minimum Viable Products to long term cases.



  • As a member of BCG’s X Delivery team, you will work with consulting teams on a diverse range of sophisticated topics

  • Provide technical support through deep understanding of relevant tools and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions

  • Work closely with development and product teams to identify and mitigate risks before software release

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to validate software functionalities, performance, and reliability

  • Implement continuous integration (CI) and continuous deployment (CD) processes to streamline testing and deployment phases

  • Collaborate on software design reviews to ensure testability and best practices are incorporated early in the development process

  • Analyze test results, identify issues, and work with development teams to resolve them promptly

  • Stay abreast of the latest testing technologies and methodologies to continuously improve testing strategies and efficiency


Must-Have Technical Skills



  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, JavaScript, and familiarity with Unix/Linux environments.

  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman).

  • Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and the ability to write and debug SQL queries.


Job Requirements



  • Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English

  • Proven track record as a Software Developer in Test or similar role, focusing on automated testing in a dynamic development environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identify and resolve issue.


Quality Assurance Responsibilities



  • Understand and implement best-fit approaches to testing, ensuring that applications and new features work as expected.

  • Maintain knowledge base of manual and automated testing.

  • Create and execute reusable automated / manual test cases and translate business logic into project requirements.

  • Leverage technologies to support business needs to attain high reusability and maintainability of current and newly developed systems.

  • Understand available automation tools and how/when they should be used.

  • Write effective unit tests and integration tests to ensure high-quality software delivery.

  • In-depth understanding of Executing System and Regression Testing.

  • Awareness of performance testing tools in an Agile environment.

  • Work independently on quality / testing tasks with minimal direction.


Business Requirement Gathering And Collaboration



  • Establish credibility by thought partnering with highly demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on application development and delivery topics; drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies.

  • Execute software testing approach and creating defined outcome; contributing to approach selection.

  • Assure proper sign-off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference; sanitizing confidential client content in marketing documents.

  • Contribute to team’s content & IP development.


Additional info


Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process.


Even if you don’t meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you.

Senior Maintenance Engineer – Rotating Equipment

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the client’s Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shape’s remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.

We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shape’s remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.
  • To be available to work at our office, in Rio de Janeiro.

Differentials

  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Application Security Engineer role at Varsity Tutors, a Nerdy Company

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Application Security Engineer to serve as a trusted partner to our software development teams. This role focuses on making our product secure by design—embedding security into how software is architected, written, deployed, and maintained. Unlike infrastructure security roles, this position centers on application-layer and code-level security, working closely with developers to enable fast, confident delivery by providing meaningful, actionable security tooling and feedback. This includes leveraging modern AI-assisted techniques to accelerate vulnerability analysis, exploit chaining, and demonstration of actual risk. You will ensure engineering teams move faster—not slower—while minimizing noise. This role is part of the IT & Security team and prioritizes embedding guardrails into developer workflows rather than enforcement gates.

About Nerdy

At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we're redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI platform fuses real-time human expertise with proprietary generative-AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale. We recruit the kind of technologists and operators you'd bet on as solo founders - people who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10-times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win.

Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

How we compete

  • AI-Native at every level From the CEO to day-one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you're not wielding AI, you're not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
  • Free-market rigor Ideas rise or fall on merit and results - no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.
  • Full-stack ownership You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug.
  • Reward for contribution Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both what you achieve and how you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded.
  • Relentless exploration Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and - because only the paranoid survive - questioning every legacy assumption along the way.
  • Is Apolitical You stay focused on mission-aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes.

If you're a technically minded builder who thrives on open competition, personal responsibility, and the chance to redefine how the world learns - while continually stretching the limits of what generative AI can do - come do the most ambitious and rewarding work of your career here. Learn more at nerdy.com.

Nerdy's shareholder letters

Nerdy's shareholder letters below explain our latest products and strategy:

  • Q2-2025 Shareholder Letter
  • Q1-2025 Shareholder Letter
  • Q4-2024 Shareholder Letter

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience as an Application Security Engineer, Security Consultant, or Security-focused Software Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability patterns.
  • Ability to apply common web application attack techniques and create proof-of-concept exploits to validate whether vulnerabilities are exploitable in our environment.
  • Proven ability to analyze exploit chains and demonstrate actual risk, leveraging AI to accelerate discovery and validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Ruby, Go, JavaScript/React, and related frameworks.
  • Deep familiarity with OWASP guidance, including the OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and Secure Coding Guidelines.
  • Partner with DevOps to embed application security into CI/CD pipeline design and practices.
  • Ability to assess and communicate application risk in architectural and business context.
  • Comfortable demonstrating real-world exploits to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in an async-first, remote environment.

Preferred

  • Experience leveraging and adapting open-source tools and frameworks for application security testing and validation.
  • Experience with API security testing and continuous monitoring, leveraging AI for fuzzing, intelligent input generation, and automated discovery.
  • Experience building or maintaining secure development training programs.
  • Security certifications (OSWE, OSCP, GIAC) are a plus but not required.

Responsibilities

  • Enable engineering teams to move quickly while embedding security into development workflows—security and speed go hand-in-hand.
  • Partner with engineering on secure use of AI services, evaluating controls such as AI gateways, prompt inspection, and policy enforcement.
  • Identify, prioritize, and implement security tooling in developer environments and CI/CD pipelines, with AI-assisted triage to reduce noise and highlight exploitable risks.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify vulnerabilities in code, APIs, and dependencies; improve secure coding awareness; and participate in design reviews and threat modeling.
  • Demonstrate practical exploit techniques to raise security awareness and drive remediation, including chaining multiple weaknesses across services to illustrate end-to-end risk.
  • Analyze vulnerabilities across code, dependencies, APIs, and logic, with AI-assisted techniques to identify and prioritize exploit chains.
  • Build or adapt automation scripts and tools for continuous security validation, using AI copilots to accelerate script generation and validation.
  • Provide coaching, documentation, and embedded training to help developers understand and apply security guidance within their workflows.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and application security threats and detection techniques.
  • Lead incident response activities as part of the incident commander rotation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of incident response runbooks and playbooks.

The Bottom Line

If you're driven by impact, energized by ownership, and excited to help shape what's next, you'll thrive here. We move fast, think big, and reward those who deliver. This isn't a traditional corporate environment - it's a place to do the most meaningful work of your career.

title: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging)
description:
Overview

Role: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging) at Canonical. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you

  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.
  • Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem
  • Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Engajar, influenciar, negociar e trabalhar em conjunto com sua equipe e com as lideranças das unidades construindo a Cultura de Segurança de pessoas e processos na UHH, sendo exemplo no cumprimento dos requisitos aplicáveis para os todos na unidade de atuação.

  • Participar ativamente de todas as investigações de incidentes e acidentes, com o objetivo de identificar as causas raízes, propor planos de ação para evitar a recorrência, bem como compartilhar os aprendizados, reportando mensalmente os dados de acidentes do trabalho, doenças ocupacionais e agentes insalubres das unidades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Dar suporte para implementação de todos os projetos de inovação para a melhoria dos processos de Segurança do Trabalho por meio de visitas técnicas, desenvolvimento de controle, levantamento de dados e outras atuações de forma a alavancar resultados da Segurança e das áreas parceiras, tais como meio ambiente, saúde e qualidade de vida nas suas unidades.
  • Realizar a gestão de documentação e atividades perigosas das subcontratadas ao que tange diretrizes de Segurança do Trabalho, controlando a documentação e inspecionando as atividades, a fim de buscar a padronização nos documentos e dos processos.

Sobre a Área

No Seu Dia a Dia

Nossa área é responsável pelas soluções de gestão de capital regulatório e econômico, um tema atual que garante a solidez de uma instituição financeira. Englobamos os seguintes tópicos: RWA (Risk-Weighted Asset) de mercado e crédito, IRRBB (Interest Rate in the banking book – sensibilidade a mudanças de taxas de juros na carteira bancária), FRTB (Fundamental Review of the Trading Book – Basel III), risco de liquidez (LCR e NSFR), controle de Funding, IPV (Independent Price Verification) – todos assuntos core de um banco de investimentos.

  • Criação e automação de processos relacionados a gestão de capital e risco regulatório (Mercado, Crédito e Liquidez) dentro de sistema proprietário do banco;
  • Aprenderá e contribuirá para uma solução criada totalmente in-house no BTG sendo incentivado a entender nos detalhes cada tópico e produto que abordarmos junto com os usuários;
  • Relacionamento próximo com as áreas de negócio e outras equipes de IT do Grupo BTG Pactual;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das plataformas criando e evoluindo processos de deploy;
  • Desenvolvimento de software seguindo metodologias ágeis e utilizando práticas de orientação a objetos e de clean code.

Esperamos De Você

  • Formação superior completa preferencialmente em engenharia, ciências da computação, ciências exatas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Base sólida em matemática e programação, interesse no mercado financeiro (ex: funcionamento dos mercados, produtos, precificação e riscos);
  • Vontade de aprender novas linguagens e tecnologias, conhecimento em programação orientada a objetos, front-end, design patterns e Cloud (AWS);

title: Senior Engineering Manager- Ubuntu
description:
Overview


Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.


We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team that delivers the essential components of Ubuntu - our system startup, compilers, language runtimes and toolchains, as well as networking and storage config and management. This is a fast-paced, problem-solving, highly technical role operating at the core of Linux server systems. As an Engineering Manager on the Foundations team, you will be at the heart of driving Ubuntu. Working at the unique intersection of the open source ecosystem, and enterprise technologists. In this pivotal position, you\'ll lead and inspire your team of engineers, to take Ubuntu to new heights. We are looking for someone with a deep understanding of Linux and Ubuntu with a passion for exceptional leadership. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery and drive your team on strategy and execution.


Location: Globally remote



Responsibilities



  • Lead and grow a team of distributed engineers

  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles through active and hands on leadership

  • Be responsible for planning, estimation and execution

  • Work with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu

  • Collaborate with cross-functional leadership teams

  • Drive the advancement and adoption of the latest software development practices

  • Design, embrace and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices

  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values

  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps

  • Work from home while meeting in person for company sprints. Sprints are typically twice a year for 1-2 weeks.



What we are looking for



  • You have worked extensively with Linux distributions, and are experienced with packaging technologies (e.g. deb, rpm, other)

  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers

  • High quality software engineering knowledge in one or more of: Linux system architecture, boot process, Java/GCC/Python/Rust/Go toolchains, ARM and/or RISC-V

  • Engagement with open source communities and processes



What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.



  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Annual compensation review

  • Recognition rewards

  • Annual holiday leave

  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.


Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

We are seeking a Databricks Data Architect who can own Lakehouse design and governance and represent that vision in front of clients. You’ll spend most of your time embedded with delivery squads—modeling data, tuning clusters, and enforcing standards—but you’ll also step into discovery workshops, help scope solutions, and support pre-sales conversations when deep architectural insight is needed.

Responsibilities

  • Client Engagement & Solution Development
    • Act as the primary technical liaison during key engagements—translating business goals into architecture that both sides understand.
    • Lead discovery workshops and roadmap sessions to surface requirements, constraints, and success metrics, then map them to scalable Databricks patterns.
    • Partner with account & sales teams to shape estimates, reference architectures, and bill-of-materials for proposals and SOWs.
    • Provide architecture-level answers for RFPs/RFIs and join pitch calls when deep Databricks credibility is essential.
    • Mentor client technical leads during early project phases to ensure knowledge transfer and long-term success.

    • Design logical/physical models, storage layers, and streaming/CDC patterns with Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.

  • Governance & Security
    • Define catalog/permission models, retention policies, and lineage artifacts to meet HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, and similar frameworks.
    • Implement row-/column-level security, tokenization, and end-to-end audit logging.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization
    • Tune cluster sizing, Photon/SQL Warehouse configs, Z-Ordering, and auto-compaction to hit SLA and cost targets.
    • Instrument dashboards for query latency, job runtimes, and spend.
    • Lead design reviews, pair with engineers on PySpark/Scala, and sign off on pull requests before production.
    • Publish best-practice templates, Terraform workspace bootstraps, and CI/CD guidelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with Platform Ops, Security, Analytics, and Product teams to translate requirements into production-ready data solutions.
    • Host lunch-and-learns and brown-bag demos to level-up Databricks skill sets across Blue Orange.

Requirements

  • 5–7 years building cloud data platforms; 3+ years hands-on with Databricks.
  • Deep expertise in Delta Lake ACID, Unity Catalog, and Spark performance tuning.
  • Proven experience architecting Lakehouse or Cloud DW solutions on two or more major clouds.
  • Strong SQL + PySpark/Scala; working knowledge of dbt, Airflow, or similar orchestrators.
  • Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification (or ability to earn in 90 days).
  • Excellent communication skills for client workshops, documentation, and mentoring.
  • Ability to engage with and communicate effectively with clients at all levels, developing technical solutions that solve their challenges and/or advance their interests.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms; adept at engaging and influencing senior management and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, particularly adept at conveying complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Self-directed and motivated with a results-driven approach, capable of achieving deliveries and outcomes independently with limited external direction.
  • Eager to learn and adapt in a rapidly evolving tech landscape.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required to meet clients and attend industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a Databricks Champion within your organization.
  • Experience migrating legacy Hadoop/Snowflake/Redshift to Lakehouse.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Feature Store, and Databricks Model Serving.
  • DataOps/CI-CD for notebooks and IaC (Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Domain depth in one of our focus verticals (FinTech, Sports Analytics, Manufacturing, etc.).
  • Experience with transactional data systems and stacks, such as Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, as well as microservices, message queues, actor-models, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Experience consulting in Retail/CPG; Manufacturing; Travel & Hospitality.
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Oracle, Sage, Workday, etc.

  • Self-starter with proven abilities leading complex client engagement deliveries, often with ambiguity and little direction.
  • Master’s, MBA, or other advanced degree a plus.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule to include evenings, nights, weekends and/or holidays with days off as assigned.

  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with students, staff, faculty, medical staff, patients, other public safety organizations of the University, Hospital and the general public.

High School Graduate or General Equivalency Diploma (GED); and Five (5) years of responsible work experience in law enforcement or security work which included two (2) years at a supervisory level or two (2) years of training in an accredited college or university in criminal justice or related field, or the equivalent combination of five (5) years combined relevant training and experience.
